Chapter 10: memory and registers (8 levels)

What the 8-bit CPU will remember with: a byte register from eight 1-bit
registers (after it the wide register part is allowed), the 8-bit
counter and the program counter with jump, a register file of four
bytes with decoder and selector, the RAM part, a stack with stack
pointer, a shift register and the 8-bit accumulator on the ALU8.
Chips made on the way: REG8, CNT8, PC8, RF4, STACK.
